title: CanonicalSnapshot
description: Frozen retrieved content, addressed by the digest of its exact bytes. The bytes themselves live in the content-addressed object store; this record is the identity and provenance. Two URLs serving identical bytes share one snapshot -- the distinct citation lineage is carried by SourceOccurrence, not here.

content_hash.description: content_id over the exact retrieved bytes. Primary key.

raw_content_format.description: What Tavily actually returned. 'markdown'/'text' are cleaned parses, NOT browser HTML bytes -- which is why the node is named WEBPAGE_P1 and not HTML_P1. 'dom_html' may only be produced by the separate secondary DOM study that fetches and freezes its own HTTP response.

object_ref.description: Key of the zstd blob in the content-addressed object store.

normalization_version.description: Version of the normalization applied before hashing. Changing it changes every content_hash and is therefore a protocol change.

http_status.description: Present only for the secondary DOM study, which performs its own fetch. Tavily does not expose the upstream status.
